mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, name, project, color_theme, order_num, created_at, updated_at FROM hackathon_teams WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY order_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hackathon_teams ( event_id, name, project, color_theme, order_num, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{name}, #{project}, #{colorTheme}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE hackathon_teams SET name = #{name}, project = #{project}, color_theme = #{colorTheme}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
